scope: Selected route matches user-reported deenergized valve route. Normal deenergized routing is not proof of every USB/switch power-failure condition or reliable depressurization.

pendingBenchMeasurement.configuration: Pumps isolated from airbag; test fixture and energy limits require review before any action
pendingBenchMeasurement.pumpOff: Measure requested-OFF to load electrical OFF criterion and actual airflow cessation; use slower response. Include signal frame/phase propagation if scope starts at a later input edge.
pendingBenchMeasurement.valve: Measure command/input change to actual route change in both directions.
pendingBenchMeasurement.repeats: Record several trials, worst observed delay and justified margin; no numeric value selected now.

activeDeflationUpdate.confirmationScope: Existing D6 pump can actively extract air during powered normal operation; no pressure-zero or independent overpressure protection claim
activeDeflationUpdate.normalCompletion: Original final deflation then both pumps OFF
activeDeflationUpdate.stopFaultAndHostTimeout: Cancel pending ON and maintain both pumps OFF; no added deflation
activeDeflationUpdate.powerLoss: Active D6 extraction unavailable without power

pressureAvailabilityFieldScope: Existing pressureLimitingAvailable/reliablePressureReliefAvailable=false describe unconfirmed independent pressure protection and reliable residual-pressure handling, not the absence of normal powered D6 extraction.
